id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

filterValuePath.description: The path to store the filter value in the data store.

searchValuePath.description:
The path to store the current search value of each filter in the data store.

This will be used to store a map of filter keys to their current search value and search filter.

gridId.description:
The id of the grid that this filter bar is directly connected to. If this property is set,
the filter bar will assume it is right above the grid, and will add the ability to show and hide columns.
In addition, saved views will also save the column visibility.

filterConfigs.description:
Configuration for the filter inputs to display in the filter bar.
The key is the filter key, and the value is the filter configuration.

displayedFilters.description: Ordered list of filter keys from {@link #filterConfigs} to display in the filter bar.

allFiltersLayout.description:
Specifies how the add filters modal is laid out.

{@link #filterConfigs} without a section will be displayed in the "Other Filters" section.

dataStoreId.description:
The data store id to use for the filter bar. This the data store the {@link #filterConfigs}
will retrieve data from.

Note that single select or multi select filters with pagination need their own
actions that cannot be reused. This is because the data will be updated as users
scroll through the options.

additionalActions.description: Additional icon actions to display in the filter bar. Only the `name`, `iconSuffix`, and `actionSuffix` are used.

title: A filter bar UI component for filtering data in asset performance applications.
name: UiApFilterBar
